description: Synthetic PoC snippets for Ambient Scribe summary grounding. Not exhaustive medical guidance.

entries.title: Chest pain documentation
entries.snippet: Chest-pain documentation should capture symptom history, relevant risk factors, objective assessment such as ECG/vitals, and follow-up or escalation plan.
entries.provenance: Project-authored PoC documentation checklist, not a clinical guideline.

entries.title: NSAID and ACE inhibitor review
entries.snippet: When NSAIDs are discussed with ACE inhibitors, consider documenting renal-risk review and safety-net advice.

entries.title: Diabetes medication review
entries.snippet: Diabetes medication changes should document glucose pattern, renal function considerations, and follow-up timing.
